stripText.remove: (The food chain is: Aquatic plants → Crustaceans → Small fish → Large fish. Each option is a stacked pyramid diagram. Option a) is an upright four-tier pyramid — widest bar at the bottom narrowing smoothly to the smallest bar at the top. Option b) is an inverted pyramid — widest bar at the top narrowing to the bottom. Option c) is an irregular three-tier figure with a wide base, a wide middle and a small top bar. Option d) is an irregular figure with a wide base, a wider middle bar than the top and a small stub below the base.)
